subject: Human Body
title: Blood Clotting
description: A short lesson to help you apply Blood Clotting.

hook.text: A cut triggers a chemical cascade.

buildup.text: Platelets are cell fragments that patrol the blood.

discovery.text: The coagulation cascade involves 13 clotting factors activating in sequence.

twist.text: Hemophilia is a genetic disorder missing one clotting factor. A small cut can bleed for hours.

climax.text: Clotting is fast, precise, and self-limiting. It seals wounds without blocking entire blood vessels.

punchline.text: Thirteen factors, perfect sequence, sealed wound.

quiz.question: What causes hemophilia?
options: Too many platelets blocking blood flow
A missing clotting factor that prevents proper coagulation
Red blood cells that are too fragile to carry oxygen
